author: feral-core
description: Capture desktop screenshots and optionally describe them with a vision model. Uses the macOS 'screencapture' binary on macOS and 'import' / gnome-screenshot / scrot on Linux; on Linux with none of those installed, and on any other OS, the call fails with a message naming what is missing. Scene analysis needs a VLM (OPENAI_API_KEY or FERAL_VLM_PROVIDER); without one the screenshot still comes back and the response carries analysis_error instead of a description.

endpoints.description: Capture a desktop screenshot and optionally analyze it with the selected vision model. For background/multitasking macOS work, copy window_id, window_pid and exact window_title from a fresh gui_computer_use__window_list row to capture only that window without activation. The tool checks identity before and after capture; stale selection returns no pixels or analysis. Optional window_app adds an exact app check. Without window_id, capture observes the foreground desktop, including other apps; region does not bind an application. Window capture cannot be combined with region. Window capture does not make global keystrokes background-safe. When analysis_error is present, the screen has not been interpreted.

params.name: region
params.description: macOS only: x,y,width,height capture region. Ignored on Linux, which always captures the whole root window. Desktop coordinates do not identify an app. Cannot be combined with window_id.

params.name: window_id
params.description: macOS only: positive CGWindowID from a fresh gui_computer_use__window_list row. Requires window_pid and exact window_title; cannot combine with region. Never inferred from coordinates.

params.name: window_pid
params.description: Exact positive PID from the same window_list row; required with window_id to reject stale/recycled window identity.

params.name: window_title
params.description: Exact title from the same window_list row; required with window_id. Preserve an explicitly empty title if the row has one.

params.name: window_app
params.description: Optional exact app name from the same window_list row; mismatches refuse capture.

params.name: analyze
params.description: If true, run scene analysis on the captured screenshot

params.name: query
params.description: Specific question about the screenshot content

params.name: include_image
params.description: Include base64 image in response (default true)

endpoints.returns_description: Screenshot metadata, optional base64 image and optional scene analysis; scoped window capture includes capture_source=macos_window and verified window_id/pid/app/title, with no pixels on stale identity.
